content.title: Discussing quantity, weight and measures — Vegetable Seller (A1)

context.setting: Your vegetable stall. Potatoes are sold by weight. Onions are also available as individual small or large ones.
context.learnerRole: Vegetable Seller; you own and run the stall alone.
context.objective: Ask how much the customer wants and confirm weight, number and size.
constraints: Use only the vegetables and amounts given in each practice.
Check unclear amounts before confirming the order.
Make no health, pesticide or certification claims.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Two small ones or two large ones?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Half a kilo and two large onions.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Two large onions, as you asked.

keyExpressions.text: Two small ones or two large ones?

vocabulary.definition: A vegetable often sold by weight.
vocabulary.example: Half a kilo of potatoes, please.

vocabulary.definition: A short word for kilogram; a unit of weight.

vocabulary.example: These potatoes weigh half a kilo.

notes: Use 'how much' for weight and 'how many' for a number of items.

items.q: A customer wants potatoes. You need the weight.
The customer wants half a kilo of potatoes and two large onions. Say both amounts.

answers: Half a kilo of potatoes and two large onions.

rolePractice.instructions: Work in pairs. Ask about weight, number and size. Repeat the complete order. The customer checks it. Then change roles.

cards.goal: Find out and confirm the order.
cards.info: You have potatoes and small or large onions. Ask for any missing amount or size.
Start with 'Potatoes and onions, please.' You want half a kilo of potatoes and two large onions. Give the amounts when asked.

performanceTask.prompt: A customer says, 'Potatoes and onions, please.' Ask for the missing details. Your partner wants one kilo of potatoes and three small onions. Confirm the complete order without reading the model.
successCriteria: Ask for the number of onions.
Confirm one kilo of potatoes and three small onions.

selfCheck: Did I ask 'how much' about weight?
Did I ask 'how many' about number?
Did I repeat the correct order?

reviewRetrieval.prompt: Later, cover the model. Ask about the weight a customer wants.
Ask about the number of onions.
reviewRetrieval.answer: How many onions do you want?

answerKey.answer: Half a kilo of potatoes and two large onions.
Possible replies: How much do you need? / How many onions do you want? / Small ones or large ones? / One kilo of potatoes. Three small onions.
